messages:
Ava: Quick sync — we need a lean copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages before next week's launch. Focus: hero clarity, 3 concise value bullets, webinar CTA, and inbound routing rules. Can we lock this by EOD Friday? :calendar: 
Claire: I can do a messaging matrix for each mode today. Recommendation: lead with performance/cost for Hosted, predictability for Dedicated, and security/compliance for Private. Short bullets (10–12 words).
Jo: I'll draft the hero lines + 3 variants per mode. Want tone: direct, engineer-friendly, but approachable. Example for Hosted: "Fast, predictable inference — start in minutes." Thoughts?
Liam: Design constraints: we need space for 1 short hero + 2-line subhead. Keep CTAs 44px tall. I'll make a responsive mock.
Ravi: Routing ask — webinar signups should go to webinar list (marketing->nurture). High intent Dedicated trials should route to sales (SDR). Private demo requests go to field-sales. Can we codify mapping?
Maya: @Ravi adding routing map here for dev to implement: ```/pages/hosted -> marketing-webinar-list /pages/dedicated -> sdr-intake-form /pages/private -> field-sales-demo``` We can tweak query params for campaign tags.
Claire: For benchmark narrative (hero + one stat), suggest: "Save up to 3x per token with inference batching" — need verification from eng on exact numbers. @deploy-bot can you surface the latest benchmark link?
deploy-bot: Benchmark doc: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/inference-2026 (most recent build 2026-02-18) :robot_face:
Jo: For webinar promo copy: "Join our live demo: accelerate inference, cut costs, and keep SLAs." Short bullets inside the page: 1) Throughput & latency, 2) Cost controls, 3) Secure/private options.
Ava: This is great. Action items: Claire = messaging matrix + hero variants (today). Jo = final hero drafts + webinar CTAs (tomorrow AM). Liam = comp + CTA placement (tomorrow). Ravi/Maya = finalize routing JSON for dev (today). I'll consolidate and send to content review.
Ravi: I'll prepare the routing JSON and include UTM specs.
Claire: Also prepping 2 benchmark blurbs: one for Hosted (cost/speed), one for Dedicated (SLA/predictable throughput). Private gets compliance & audit mention.
Jo: Will add microcopy for form confirmations and thank-you emails.
Ava: Cool — if we hit EOD Friday, we can ship the staged landing on Monday and push webinar promo Tue. Any blockers?
Liam: None from design.
Ravi: Need eng sign-off on benchmark numbers — pinging @eng-ml.
Ava: Thanks, team. I'll post an updated doc later with links. :sparkles:
